source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) & Current Population Survey

occupations.title: Software Engineering, DevOps & QA
occupations.description: Software developers, systems architects, QA automation engineers, and database administrators.

junior.exposure_profile: Routine CRUD development, standard boilerplate, unit test writing, basic bug remediation.

mid.exposure_profile: Feature development, integration testing, API design, code refactoring.

senior.exposure_profile: Distributed system architecture, security auditing, cross-service reliability, production incident response.

occupations.title: Legal Services & Compliance
occupations.description: Attorneys, judicial law clerks, paralegals, and legal assistants.

junior.exposure_profile: Document discovery, deposition summarization, contract template parsing, cite checking.

mid.exposure_profile: Standard litigation briefs, commercial contract drafting, regulatory filing preparation.

senior.exposure_profile: Trial advocacy, high-stakes negotiation, regulatory enforcement defense, partner-level fiduciary liability.

occupations.title: Finance, Accounting & Auditing
occupations.description: Financial analysts, accountants, auditors, bookkeepers, and credit specialists.

junior.exposure_profile: Accounts reconciliation, data ledger entry, standard variance reporting, junior audit checklists.

mid.exposure_profile: Financial modeling, tax compliance filing, internal controls assessment, divisional forecasting.

senior.exposure_profile: Capital structure allocation, treasury management, complex M&A underwriting, audit opinion sign-off.

occupations.title: Customer Support & Contact Center Operations
occupations.description: Customer service representatives, helpdesk operators, and contact center agents.

junior.exposure_profile: Tier-1 ticket routing, knowledge base lookup, order tracking inquiries, password resets.

mid.exposure_profile: Tier-2 technical troubleshooting, billing dispute resolution, customer retention calls.

senior.exposure_profile: High-value VIP enterprise escalation, customer success relationship management, team leadership.

occupations.title: Marketing, Copywriting, Design & Localization
occupations.description: Marketing specialists, copywriters, graphic designers, technical writers, and translators.

junior.exposure_profile: SEO article writing, social media blurbs, stock graphic formatting, routine translation.

mid.exposure_profile: Campaign copywriting, digital ad performance optimization, UI asset creation.

senior.exposure_profile: Brand identity, creative direction, high-profile product launch narrative, strategic market positioning.

occupations.title: Management Consulting & Market Research Analysts
occupations.description: Management consultants, strategy analysts, and market research specialists.

junior.exposure_profile: Competitive landscape synthesis, slide deck formatting, survey data cleaning, secondary research.

mid.exposure_profile: Commercial due diligence workstreams, organizational redesign analysis, client interview synthesis.

senior.exposure_profile: C-suite strategic counsel, client board presentations, deal sourcing, partner-level account ownership.

occupations.title: Administrative Support & Executive Assistants
occupations.description: Executive secretaries, administrative assistants, medical secretaries, and data entry keyers.

junior.exposure_profile: Calendar scheduling, email draft filtering, expense report entry, data transcription.

mid.exposure_profile: Travel itinerary coordination, vendor invoice reconciliation, department logistics.

senior.exposure_profile: Confidential C-suite gatekeeping, board of directors meeting execution, executive chief-of-staff coordination.
